newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAISIO UP SHARPLY ON OVERSEAS DEMAND.
newsitem.headline: RAISIO UP SHARPLY ON OVERSEAS DEMAND.

text.p: Shares in Finnish food, animal feed and chemicals group Raision Tehtaat rose sharply on Monday, hitting a new all-time high on overseas demand after news CS First Boston was keeping a buy recommendation on the share.
At 1340/1140 GMT, Raisio was traded up 18.00 markka, or 4.75 percent, at a new life-high of 397.00. Volume was lively at over 14 million markka.
Brokers said Raisio was already firm but gained further after the CSFB news.
"This was the same message as before. But it also seems now that the raw material problem is no longer an issue," one said.
He was referring to Raisio's need for raw materials for its cholesterol-reducing margarine Benecol.
Raisio's preferred K share also rose sharply, gaining 20.00 markka or about five and a half percent, to 385.00 markka.
